blocks.text: Real-world analogue: Municipal pumping stations, underground reservoirs, flood-control tunnels, concrete spillways, brutalist service basements, and vast cisterns beneath an occupied city.

World relation: A human-built precursor to Crafted World environmental systems, later interpreted through Quiet survival practice. Its inhabitants turn functional infrastructure into concealed social space.

Connection to newer locations: Sublevel connects naturally to the Wet Memory Marsh, Inland Sea of Doors, Monsoon Stepwell City, Sunken Terraces of Eris, and City of Rainward Roofs through water control and the danger of “correct” systems ignoring changed conditions.
Abstract or metaphorical relation: A green indicator can mean that a function survives after the person or context has been removed. Perfect operation can become the visual mask of erasure.
